verdict.rationale: Scheduling automation is a fair question for an agentic video-production tool, so the axis applies. The only scheduling evidence is `post-video --at <time>` (reelmimic-gh-9), which schedules a single social-media publish of a finished video. That is an adjacent one-off posting feature, not recurring jobs or workflows. Nothing in the pack shows cron-like or repeating schedules for generation workflows, and resume-after-limit (reelmimic-docs-10) is unrelated.
